module: Node "Hide Loading Screen" (once_instant). Hides the loading screen after a level has loaded (useful with "Load Level" in customLoadingScreen mode). Has no effect if no level is loading. Output: finished (flow).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

workOnce.desc: Sets finished to false, calls modules.level:finishedLevelLoading() and server.fadeoutLoadingScreen(true).

work.desc: Sets finished to true as soon as modules.level is no longer loading a level.
